description: This file contains the server-side logic for the Basket index page in an e-commerce web application. It manages the retrieval, updating, and addition of items to a shopping basket, handling user sessions via cookies and user authentication.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: PageModel class for managing shopping basket operations on the Basket index page, including adding items, updating quantities, and handling user authentication and cookies.

methods.name: IndexModel
methods.description: Constructor injecting basket service, view model service, and item repository dependencies.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve or create the user's basket view model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add an item to the basket based on submitted product details.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update quantities of multiple basket items.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the existing basket cookie or creates a new user identifier cookie for anonymous users.
